scope: All competitions in configs/analysis-scope.json, each fitted and scored separately. All score labels are regulation-time goals.
source_reference: R8 ac7ed93ecb1d16c387c0b38e62af09902d3f1a13, R8 data 7e9e6a2f9603142e7f65d665998697b5a8836c12, R7 data 949047955a2eba0c1cdec51ad08ac91bc5fb05d4, R5 panels a2c680dfe403e48d2745c722eb7f0c036ab8d651.
signal: For each team within its competition and exact source phase, accumulate exponentially decayed observed and pre-match expected frequencies of 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4+ goals scored and conceded. Expectations use the R7 unfitted, chronological market/team anchor. Read features for all fixtures of a date before applying any result. Use the R7 competition half-life, and virtual bucket counts [2, 2.5, 2, 1, 0.5] for both observed and expected. Clip log observed/expected ratios at +/- log(3). Unknown team or phase contributes zero.
model: An exponential tilt across all 25 paired buckets. In a score cell, add the effects for both attacks and for both opponents' concessions, with two coefficients per competition. Fit against the chronological anchor on the training fold, using exact score likelihood, ridge penalty 8/2 times the squared coefficient norm, and coefficient bounds [-1,1]. Relative probabilities within each paired bucket follow the underlying matrix. At evaluation and forward issue, tilt the full R7 matrix. All four selections come from the resulting joint distribution.
selection: Only the second, chronological validation fold may choose intensity among 0, 0.5 and 1. Order by correct first scores, correct ordered-three sets, lowest exact-score log loss, then smallest intensity. Empty validation uses 0. Keep the fixed-intensity-1 predictions as an ablation, including when the selected intensity is 0. No new variants after seeing a test score.
held_out: Replay unchanged R7 main/recent and 2009/10 windows on identical fixtures/lines, checking original R7 and R8 picks. For a separate older historical test use six leagues (eng.1, esp.1, ger.1, ita.1, fra.1, ned.1) and sources football-data.co.uk 2002/03 and 2003/04 to fit, 2004/05 to validate, 2005/06 to test. Independently refit R7, R8 and R9 on that window's past. Keep fixtures with missing prices and identify market coverage. Historical quote receipt times are unknown.
report: All four project KPIs by competition, coverage and the five actual Asian settlements. Pair with R7, R8 and available pure-market picks. Report date-cluster 95% intervals using the repository bootstrap. Classify the actual score by its exact stable R7 rank (1, 2-3, 4-6, 7-10, 11+), and count rescues and losses at ranks 1 and 3.
forward: Refit the same two coefficients on the complete historical panel for forward inference. Keep the validation-selected intensity and bind artifacts to the exact R7 forward recipe. Freeze the first R9 research choices on still-unstarted fixtures from the R8 first issues with the identical source odds. Collect subsequent regulation-time outcomes independently.
decision: First-score is the priority. Treat a gain as repeatable historical evidence only if both primary and three-score net gains are positive in the main and the new 2005/06 windows, with the main primary paired lower 95% bound above zero. Report recent and 2009/10 separately. Consider any active switch only under the established project rules and independent first-issue evidence.
